api_token.description: Gigahost API token used as a bearer token (for example `flux_live_...`). Create one under **Account → API keys**. May also be set with the `GIGAHOST_API_TOKEN` environment variable.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Gigahost API. Defaults to `https://api.gigahost.no/api/v0`. May also be set with the `GIGAHOST_BASE_URL` environment variable.

block.description: The Gigahost provider manages resources on a [Gigahost](https://gigahost.no) account through the [Gigahost API](https://gigahost.no/en/api-dokumentasjon).

record_priority.description: Priority (used by MX and SRV records).

record_ttl.description: Time to live, in seconds; defaults to 3600.

zone_id.description: Id of the DNS zone that contains the record.

block.description: Manages a DNS record within a Gigahost DNS zone.

source.description: Subdomain the redirect applies to; defaults to "@" (the zone root).

target_url.description: URL that requests are redirected to.

zone_id.description: Id of the DNS zone that contains the redirect.

block.description: Manages an HTTP redirect for a Gigahost DNS zone.

external_dns.description: Whether the zone is served by external nameservers.

zone_protected.description: Whether the zone is protected against deletion.

block.description: Manages a DNS zone on the Gigahost account.

backups.description: Whether to enable daily backups (adds 25% to the price).

hostname.description: Requested hostname. Stored by the API as the server's initial name (`srv_name`); unset after import.

ips.description: IP addresses assigned to the server.

monthly_cap.description: Monthly price cap (the most charged per month).

order_number.description: Human-facing order number for the deployment.

os_dist.description: OS image to install, by release codename (`os_dist`), e.g. "noble". Provide `os_name` or `os_dist` (to install an OS), or `rescue`.

os_id.description: Resolved OS image id (from os_name or os_dist).

os_name.description: OS image to install, by catalog name (`os_name`), e.g. "Ubuntu 24.04 LTS". Provide `os_name` or `os_dist` (to install an OS), or `rescue`.

password.description: Initial root password (only set when the server is deployed without an SSH key). Stored in Terraform state in plaintext.

product_name.description: Product name from the catalog, e.g. "KVM Value VPS 4GB".

region_name.description: Region name to deploy in, e.g. "Sandefjord".

rescue.description: Boot the server into rescue mode instead of installing an OS.

srv_name.description: Descriptive name for the server. When unset, the server keeps its initial name.

srv_primary_ip.description: Primary IP address. Additional addresses, including IPv6, are in `ips`.

ssh_keys.description: Ids of SSH keys to authorize on the server. Changing this replaces the server. The API does not return deployed keys, so this is unset after `terraform import`; on imported servers, omit `ssh_keys` or use `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [ssh_keys] }` to avoid replacement.

create.description: A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

block.description: Deploys and manages an hourly-billed Gigahost cloud server — a KVM virtual machine or a dedicated (bare metal) server, depending on the chosen product.

key_added.description: When the key was added (Unix timestamp, string-encoded).

block.description: Manages an SSH key on the Gigahost account.
Retrieves the authenticated Gigahost account profile.

record_priority.description: Priority (used by MX and SRV records).

record_type.description: Record type (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS, etc.).

zone_id.description: Id of the DNS zone to list records for.

block.description: Lists the DNS records in a Gigahost DNS zone.

external_dns.description: Whether the zone is served by external nameservers.

zone_name.description: Domain name of the zone to look up.

zone_protected.description: Whether the zone is protected against deletion.

block.description: Looks up a single DNS zone by domain name.

external_dns.description: Whether the zone is served by external nameservers.

zone_protected.description: Whether the zone is protected against deletion.

block.description: Lists the DNS zones on the Gigahost account.

os_custom_partition.description: Whether the image supports custom partitioning.

os_dedicated_only.description: Whether the image is only deployable on dedicated servers.

os_dist.description: Look up the image by its release codename, e.g. "noble".

os_id.description: OS image id, used as os_id when deploying a gigahost_server.

os_name.description: Look up the image by its full name, e.g. "Ubuntu 24.04 LTS".

os_single_disk_only.description: Whether the image must be installed on a single disk.

block.description: Looks up a deployable OS image by name or release codename, returning the os_id used by the gigahost_server resource.

ips.description: IP addresses assigned to the server.

srv_date_created.description: Creation time (Unix epoch, as a string).

srv_hostname.description: Server hostname; not populated by the API.

srv_id.description: Look up the server by id.

srv_name.description: Look up the server by name.

srv_status_rescue.description: Whether the server is in rescue mode.

block.description: Looks up a single server by id or name.

regions.description: Regions servers can be deployed in.

price_id.description: Price id for the product, used when deploying.

rate_monthly.description: Monthly cap (the most charged per month).

region_ids.description: Ids of the regions this product can be deployed in.

tiers.description: Server product tiers available for hourly deployment.

block.description: Lists the hourly cloud server catalog: tiers, products, and regions.

ips.description: IP addresses assigned to the server.

srv_hostname.description: Server hostname; not populated by the API.

srv_name.description: Server name. Initially the requested deploy hostname, or auto-generated.

srv_status_rescue.description: Whether the server is in rescue mode.

block.description: Lists the servers on the Gigahost account.

key_added.description: When the key was added (Unix timestamp, string-encoded).

ssh_keys.description: SSH public keys registered on the account.

block.description: Lists the SSH keys registered on the Gigahost account.
